final_followup.result: Notes permission gates, mounted tests, version and documentation changes add no standards issue. STD-01 remains accepted without code change. Tests were inspected, not rerun.

findings.disposition_reason: Substantive byte-reading, cancellation and draining mechanisms are already shared by readRequestText and RequestLifetime. Remaining route policy differs intentionally; whole-route abstraction would require substantial configuration and could obscure security and lifecycle boundaries. No current remediation or repeated tests required; reconsider only for demonstrated policy drift.
findings.reason: Authenticated JSON request boundary repeats across route modules, scattering changes to admission, parsing and shutdown behavior.
findings.recommendation: Consider a shared small route boundary with per-route limits and dispatch; preserve explicit availability and lifetime ownership.
findings.validation: Parameterized HTTP tests for authentication, unavailable owner, malformed and oversized JSON, and shutdown during an incomplete request body.

limitations: Targeted framework standards review; no runtime writes or tests.
Native-skin CSS rule scope ambiguous; not raised as a hard violation.
